lab_server.storage: local NVMe for every input, output and scratch file

cloud_instance.instance_type: AWS m6id.16xlarge limited to 32 virtual CPUs and 126 GiB of memory
cloud_instance.storage: two local NVMe devices in RAID0
cloud_instance.used_for: 10x 320k scFFPE only, because its Cell Ranger run needs about 3 TB of scratch

method: STAR Suite 1.9.4 Flex (--flex yes: half-probe hash cascade, no read alignment, no genome index loaded, tag-aware cell calling of pooled sample tags) was compared with Cell Ranger 9.0.1 multi on JAX SC2300771 (4 tags, 2.011 billion read pairs; our own Cell Ranger run), GSE325982 (4 single-tag samples, 1.121 billion read pairs; the submitters' own Cell Ranger 9.0.1 outputs) and the 10x 320k scFFPE GEM-X dataset (16 tags pooled into 8 samples, 7.303 billion read pairs; our own Cell Ranger run). Inputs were the delivered FASTQ (parallel in-process BGZF reader for JAX and 320k; the single plain-gzip GSE325982 pair through --readFilesCommand rapidgzip) or CBQ converted once from the FASTQ, conversion excluded. Runs were made one at a time on a quiet machine with the page cache dropped first; elapsed time is whole-process wall-clock time from /usr/bin/time. Cell Ranger 9.0.1 ran with BAM output and secondary analysis disabled at the same thread count and was timed to completion. A Flex cell is its 16-base barcode with its sample tag; the Jaccard is pooled over samples, the per-cell Pearson is the mean over samples of per-cell Pearson correlations of log counts for genes with at least 20 counts detected in at least 1% of shared cells, and the gene-level correlations are computed per sample and averaged. Gene-level concordance is the Spearman correlation (tied ranks averaged) and the Pearson correlation of raw per-gene count totals over the cells called by both tools, over every gene in both annotations, zero-count genes included.
limitations: Each timing is one completed run rather than a replicated distribution.
The 320k rows were measured on a cloud instance sized like the lab server, not on the lab server itself.
Flex cell calls depend on the number of EmptyDrops bootstrap streams; these runs used 32.
The JAX SC2300771 data are MorPhiC consortium data; only aggregate metrics are published here.
Cell Ranger outputs are the comparator, not a ground truth.
